headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 1, 2026**
article:
The MLB season continued with several notable performances and roster moves. The Baltimore Orioles dominated the Chicago White Sox, securing a 6-1 victory. In the American League Central, the Cleveland Guardians cruised past the Texas Rangers 9-4, while the Washington Nationals routed the Boston Red Sox 10-2. The Detroit Tigers also secured a 6-2 victory over the New York Yankees.

Several key players have been affected by injuries, with the San Francisco Giants placing third baseman Matt Chapman on the 10-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. The Kansas City Royals have also placed left-handed pitcher Kris Bubic on the 60-day injured list with left elbow soreness and right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold on the 15-day injured list with a right lat strain. Other teams have also reported injuries to key players, including the Texas Rangers' Corey Seager, the Detroit Tigers' Will Vest, the Boston Red Sox's Connelly Early, the Miami Marlins' Anthony Bender, and the Houston Astros' Jeremy Peña.

The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas, acquired in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles. Nicolas joins the Nationals in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz. Other notable trades include the Athletics trading third baseman Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for right-handed pitcher Ben Hansen and the Texas Rangers trading catcher Ben Hartl to the Chicago White Sox for right-handed pitcher Ben Peoples.

top_news.title: **Orioles Cruise Past White Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles dominated the Chicago White Sox, securing a 6-1 victory. Sam Antonacci led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Noah Schultz pitched 4.1 innings with 7 strikeouts for the White Sox.

top_news.title: **Guardians Cruise Past Rangers 9-4**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a convincing 9-4 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Joey Cantillo earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Austin Hedges led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Rout Red Sox 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 10-2 victory. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Yankees 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 6-2 victory over the New York Yankees, with Keider Montero earning the win. Kevin McGonigle led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Chapman on Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants third baseman Matt Chapman has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. The move was made on July 1, 2026.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire Kyle Nicolas in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas, acquired in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles. Nicolas joins the Nationals in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz.
